0022600003.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Oklahoma City Thunder visit the San Antonio Spurs. Oklahoma City is missing Otega Oweh, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jaylin Williams, Nikola Topic, and Thomas Sorber are all listed as day-to-day, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance, who is out after knee surgery, and Tobias Harris, who is day-to-day with a calf strain. The Thunder lost the 2025-26 regular-season series 1-4 and the 2025-26 playoff series 3-4, most recently falling 111-103 to San Antonio on May 30, 2026, in Oklahoma City. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Oklahoma City a 45% chance to win.
